Happy brands. I create expressive, colorful designs for fashion brands that want something people are genuinely drawn to. Exclusive and custom sales only! View Pattern Library Select from available prints Browse my current collection and find the print that fits your brand. Each design has its own personality and is ready to become part of your next piece. Apply to Shop Two ways to work together Collaborate Work on custom prints together Have something specific in mind? We'll work together to bring it to life. It's a collaborative back-and-forth process so the final design feels totally yours. Reach Out Ready to stand out? Approved clients access the full portfolio. New brands start with an application. Apply Now Questions Everything you need to know about working with me and accessing my prints. What makes prints exclusive? Each design is sold once, to one brand. When you purchase a print, it's yours. No one else will ever use it. How do I apply? Head to the Apply to Shop page here and fill out a quick form with your brand info, target market, and aesthetic. Simple as that. How long is the process? For custom projects, from creative brief to final delivery, most projects take about 2 to 3 weeks depending on scope. Can I customize design? Yes! If you're an approved client, we can work together on something custom that fits your brand collection perfectly. How do I access the shop? Once you're approved, you'll get login credentials to browse the full portfolio of available prints and collections. What file formats do you deliver? Files are delivered in Photoshop or Illustrator, ready to hand off to your production team. Get in touch Reach out with questions about collaborations or the application process. --> About | Heatherraney top of page Home About Shop All Prints Animal Conversationals Patchwork Stripe All Prints Animal Conversationals Patchwork Stripe Portfolio Services Contact Request Access Log In Hi, I'm Heather Hey, I'm Heather! I'm a print designer and illustrator based in the mountains of Idaho, and I've been obsessed with textiles and pattern for as long as I can remember.I studied Apparel Design and spent years working in the fashion industry before going out on my own. Now I create original textile prints for womenswear, blending hand-painted techniques with trend-driven color stories. Think whimsical florals, global-inspired motifs, ikat, block prints, bold botanicals. Expressive, seasonally relevant prints that actually have something to say. Every design I sell is exclusive and buyout-ready, meaning it's yours and yours alone. Want to work together? Browse my collection or reach out at hello@heatherraney.com . The W.I.P. Report ‍My monthly newsletter where I share what I'm working on, fresh studio updates, and the trend reports and color stories I create for print and pattern lovers. It's a behind-the-scenes look into my world of womenswear print design. Whether you're a designer, art director, or just genuinely curious, come hang. Sign up below!
